title: RNAseq of freshly isolated and ex vivo expanded peripheral blood NK cells
description: NK cells were isolated from the perpheral blood of healthy donors (n=6) and expanded ex vivo in the presence of feeder cells and IL-2. RNA from fresh and expanded cells was isolated, sequenced, and gene expression of the cell populations were compared. Overall design: Examiniation of gene transcription by FPKM

samples.title: F6: Peripheral blood NK cells
attributes: 12hrs in X-vivo20 (Lonza) + 10% heat inactivated human serum, 37° C
